summary: Focused P0 testing for Corner Streams: WhatsApp-verified payment gate (P0#1), report-card upgrades (P0#10) and parent children list bug (P0#11). 14/14 backend tests pass (new /app/backend/tests/p0_test.py); frontend Playwright e2e validated register->/pending redirect, pending page content (UBA / 2936722942 / Mervyndean / tier / duration / WhatsApp deep link / receipt + 6-digit code inputs), super admin verification queue with Generate-code dialog showing 6-digit code + WhatsApp deep-link, and ReportCard with brand_color #002147 borders, logo box, 'Subjects scored: 6 of 6', Remark column ('Excellent'), and principal+teacher comment boxes. All seeded role logins still work and /api/superadmin/stats includes pending_schools.
action_items: (Optional) Parent dashboard children list loads slightly after networkidle — consider showing a loading skeleton instead of the 'No children linked' empty state during the brief fetch window so users don't see a misleading message on slow networks.

(Optional) Add data-testid attributes to ReportCard subject rows + principal/teacher comment containers, parent-dashboard child-card 'Term result' buttons, and super-admin 'Generate code' / 'Approve' / 'Reject' action buttons for more robust selectors in future Playwright tests.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.register: response intentionally omits token/user (payment gate). Good.
superadmin.verify_school approve path: subscription tier/duration/expires_at pulled from latest pending bank-receipt and kill_switch reset — verified end-to-end. No _id leakage.
payments.bank-receipt-public: flips school to 'pending_code' only (not 'active'); approval still requires super admin verify. Verified.

reports.get_report: principal_comment/teacher_comment grade brackets are exclusive (>=75 produces 'excellently'/'outstanding') — confirmed for Adaeze 86.5% avg. Bracket boundaries (e.g. exactly 75 or exactly 65) covered; lowest bracket is correctly the catch-all 'else'.
students list query for parent role now uses case-insensitive regex match on parent_email — verified both Adaeze and Emeka returned (backend test_11 passed).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on P0 flows (4/4: register->pending redirect, pending page content, super-admin queue + code dialog, ReportCard upgrades + brand color)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_p0_*@example.com schools (one approved, one rejected) and one extra TEST_uiqueue_* school used in the live super-admin queue UI test. They remain in DB but are isolated by TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/p0_test.py -v` (needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported). Also iteration_2.json's 45-test full suite still passes. P0#1 e2e gate, P0#10 report upgrades and P0#11 parent children list are fully verified.
